final: WITH race_names AS (SELECT races.name, SUM(results.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(results.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps FROM results JOIN races ON races.raceId = results.raceId GROUP BY races.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_total FROM race_names) SELECT SUM(race_names.total_points) AS sum_total_points, AVG(race_names.average_laps) AS average_laps, AVG(race_names.total_points - overall.average_total) AS average_excess_points FROM race_names CROSS JOIN overall WHERE race_names.total_points > overall.average_total
